newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-DAWSON HELPS W.PROVINCE NET 238-7 VS NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-DAWSON HELPS W.PROVINCE NET 238-7 VS NATAL.

text.p: A quickfire 27 not out from all-rounder Alan Dawson elevated Western Province to an impressive 238 for seven against Natal in the second leg of their Standard Bank Cup final at Kingsmead on Sunday.

Dawson struck his runs from just 11 balls with two sixes and two fours as the visitors took advantage of both a pitch offering a little pace and bounce and some erratic bowling from Lance Klusener and Dale Benkenstein.
After winning the toss, Western Province began with a first-wicket stand of 86 in 20 overs between Gary Kirsten (63) and Herschelle Gibbs (40).
But after the dismissal of Gibbs -- caught at deep square leg off the medium pace of Neil Johnson -- Natal were able to curb the W.Province run rate.

Off-spinner Pat Symcox bowled superbly for figures of 1-30 in nine overs of varied pace and flight and he removed the key wicket of Kirsten, stumped by Keith Forde, after beating him with turn and bounce.

Although fellow off-spinner Derek Crookes also bowled well for a final return of 2-51, H.D. Ackerman (42) and all-rounder Brian McMillan (31) upped the tempo with a fourth-wicket partnership of 63 at a run a ball.
Dawson's aggressive cameo at the end gave W.P. an average run-rate of 5.3 for their innings and a total probably 20 runs better than par at Kingsmead.
Western Province won Friday's first leg in the final by six wickets at Newlands.
Did not bat: C.Matthews, B.Schultz, P.Adams.
Bowling: Pollock 7.5-0-33-0, Johnson 9-0-38-2, Klusener 7-0-44-0, Benkenstein 3.1-0-20-0, Symcox 9-0-30-1, Crookes 9-1-51-2.
Natal: A.Hudson, L.Klusener, D.Watson, N.Johnson, D.Crookes, J.Rhodes, D.Benkenstein, E.Stewart, S.Pollock, P.Symcox, K.Forde.
